a.xlink:title: Private assistant you talk to from a dashboard. Target live Oct 30.
Stage 0: shared code, docs, checks, risk list. Checks, development setup, and threat model are all done.
Stage 1: ask, answer, approve, pay, demo. Every work item done.
Stage 2: survives ordinary use. Serve entry, health checks, restart recovery, real document search, observability, repeatable quality measurements, and the deploy assets and runbook are done.
Stage 3: privacy and cost promises hold. Abuse resistance, spend ceilings, invoke-time policy, retention, owner sign-in, and the written privacy review are all done.
Stage 4: more devices, scheduled work, outside abilities, and sharing. Every work item is done.
Where you talk to the assistant: screen now, phone apps later.
How money moves: Stripe saved cards and Razorpay Checkout, both merged and closed out. Balance later.
Screen plan is written. Drawing file is next, no code yet.
Six small fixes and papers closing the honest gaps M1 to M4 left open. Every task merged and reviewed on 2 November 2026.
Credential handoff, stable share-ID test, and wallet/Checkout server mounting are merged. Main collects 1106 tests: 1102 pass and 4 skip.
Shared code copy plus docs live. Finished.
Secret scan, lint, type check, tests, and a dependency audit run on every push. Finished.
Written list of what could go wrong: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md. Finished.
Rulebook every new ability follows. Finished.
Engine: reads, thinks, answers bit by bit. Merged and reviewed.
Checkpoint that asks you before acting. Merged and reviewed.
Main screen you talk through. Surface merged to main; the browser screen is next.
Pay with a saved card or hosted Checkout after you say yes. Merged and closed out on owner confirmation.
Six-scene demo that proves it works. Merged and reviewed.
One command serves the app: ordered boot, clean shutdown, restart recovery. Merged and reviewed.
Liveness and readiness probes with bounded, cached dependency checks that leak no secrets. Merged and reviewed.
PDF and CSV ingestion, chunking, hybrid ranking, and answers quoted with page and row citations. Merged and reviewed.
One request id per turn, JSON log lines with no private text, and Prometheus metrics. Merged and reviewed.
One offline command proves the MVP behaviours still hold; a labelled second run checks the real model. Merged and reviewed.
One image, one Compose file, one systemd unit, and a runbook a stranger can follow. Merged and reviewed; proven locally, not yet run on a hosted VM.
Picks up after a restart with nothing lost. Merged and reviewed.
Health and readiness checks name a failing dependency. Merged and reviewed.
Finds the right bit of your documents and quotes where it came from. Merged and reviewed.
Logs and metrics let an operator follow one turn and its failures without reading private text. Merged and reviewed.
One offline command proves the MVP behaviours still hold, with gates that fail the run on a regression. Merged and reviewed.
Image, Compose file, systemd unit, health probe, and a runbook that a stranger can follow. Proven locally on 30 October; the hosted VM run is the next step.
Five limiter classes, a body ceiling checked before the read, two concurrency caps, and a refusal counter per class. Merged and reviewed.
Day and month dollar caps computed from persisted usage, one warning at 80%, a hard stop at 100%. Merged and reviewed.
Every skill call is checked against its declared effects, paths, hosts, and repos, and a deny is final. Merged and reviewed.
Hard delete, orphan sweep, space reclaimed, and a written clock per data class. Merged and reviewed.
A session cookie, CSRF on every change, an auth trail, and a lockout after repeated failures. Merged and reviewed.
Every outbound recipient named in writing, one content-free egress row per call, and an exec boundary stated plainly. Merged and reviewed.
Sign-in gates every route, keys stay server-side, and a wrong credential is counted and locked out. Merged and reviewed.
Five limiter classes, a body ceiling read before the body, two concurrency caps, and a refusal counter per class. Merged and reviewed.
Declared effects and scopes are enforced when a skill runs, not just described. Merged and reviewed.
What you delete is gone, and every data class has a stated clock. Merged and reviewed.
Day and month dollar ceilings from persisted usage, one warning at 80%, a hard stop at 100%. Merged and reviewed.
Every recipient named, every egress counted without content, and no command path in this build. Merged and reviewed.
Scheduled tasks live as one file each and fire on a five-field cron in their own timezone; every fire, miss, and expired window is audited. Merged and reviewed.
Owner sessions persist in the chat database: several devices survive a restart, list each other, and revoke one another. Merged and reviewed.
Abilities from others install from a directory or zip, are pinned by SHA-256, and load by file path without changing sys.path. Merged and reviewed.
Written decision: one owner, and everyone else gets only a per-thread, revocable, read-only link. Merged and reviewed.
A due scheduled task becomes an ordinary assistant turn through the same service, guards, and stream; spend, concurrency, and hourly caps plus a failure breaker keep it bounded. Merged and reviewed.
A per-thread, revocable, read-only link that shows one frozen snapshot, stored as a hash and rate-limited with no owner session. Merged and reviewed.
Main screen in the browser. Built first.
Mirror of the same assistant, same rules. Next.
Not in this round. Later.
No recording or listening work yet. Later.
Save once, pay after approval, receipt each time. Merged and closed out.
Hosted Checkout plus a saved-card gateway. Merged, reviewed, and closed out on owner confirmation.
Topping up and ledger wait. Later.
Thirteen screens, three flows, four states each. Finished.
Money screens get big numbers and plain words. Finished.
Drawing file next, then code. Not started.
What each tool takes in, gives back, may touch. Finished.
Web search, GitHub read, file answers, scheduler. Finished.
Adding a tool is a small contained job. Finished.
Words appear as they arrive. Merged and reviewed.
Asks a small program to do one thing, feeds back result. Merged and reviewed.
Hard limit on steps and length, tallies price. Merged and reviewed.
Nothing changes something without a yes. Merged and reviewed.
Approval names exact action, works once, then expires. Merged and reviewed.
Every decision logged, keys removed. Merged and reviewed.
Conversations you name and pick up later. Merged to main.
PDF and table previews plus where answers came from. Merged to main.
Yes or no shown in the conversation, over one-time approvals. Merged to main.
Order, signature check, settlement, webhook. Merged, reviewed, and closed out.
Cards kept by the processor, charged only with approval. Merged and closed out.
Spending rules that block over-limit pays. Merged and tested.
What was done, when, and how much. Merged; receipt check rides on the next live run.
Ask, files, GitHub, approve, schedule, restart. Merged to main.
Make-believe model answers so the run repeats. Merged to main.
A receipt per scene, an error if one fails. Merged to main.
Trust boundaries, what reaches the model, what stays server-side: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md. Merged and reviewed.
Failure, skip, and pause counters update under the tick lock; a 12-thread test proves no increment is lost. Merged and reviewed.
Sign-in, revoke, and mass revoke each leave one content-free audit row with a hash prefix only. Merged and reviewed.
Every forbidden snapshot field enumerated in one deny-list and tested absent by an exhaustive walk. Merged and reviewed.
Ed25519 attestation prototype over the digest pin plus the spike paper; enforcement is a named follow-up. Merged and reviewed.
Provider swap runbook: env switches, pricing table, evals, rollback. Merged and reviewed.
PR #20: browser credential handoff and encrypted vault, with server routes and tests. Merged as 33e6d9a.
PR #25: make the share public-ID casing assertion deterministic. Merged as 80f1eec.
Wallet and Checkout routes mounted in the server app with route-level tests. Merged as f17661b.
